author: HelloImJohnC43
quote: I’m so sad I waited 13 years for this. The game makes me feel blind, it’s very hard to play. And I don’t like how you can’t choose to play solo, instead of being forced into a relationship. I don’t want that. I don’t want a relationship. My wife and I broke up a decade ago, being forced to play gta in a relationship is so unecessary. I mean, why do I have to?
